Name: Happy Birthday SVE English Content Pack
Author: brifoundthebingus
Description:
Adds dialogue lines, mail entries, and gift data for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Alpha_Omegasis's Happy Birthday[/url] to most NPCs from Stardew Valley Expanded, including additional data for spouses.

Along with Content Patcher and obviously SMAPI, you will need Happy Birthday and all of Happy Birthday's dependencies to use this pack.

[b]Install like any other mod: extract the contained [HBD] folder into your mods folder.[/b]

Please let me know if you run into any errors or have any gift suggestions I should add. Right now, I believe only vanilla items are registered gifts in Happy Birthday. I'm unsure of the right syntax to register modded items, but it is something I want to look into.
